{
  "problem": "Design a minimalist REST API for task management and output the API contract strictly as a JSON document.",
  "objectives": [
    "Define RESTful endpoints and resources for task management.",
    "Maintain a strictly minimalist scope for the API design.",
    "Deliver the API contract structured entirely as a JSON document."
  ],
  "deliverables": [
    "A valid JSON document representing the API contract.",
    "A defined Task resource model including core attributes.",
    "Endpoint definitions covering standard CRUD operations for tasks."
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "The architecture must strictly follow REST principles.",
    "The design must be minimalist, avoiding unnecessary complexity.",
    "The final output must be exclusively valid JSON without any surrounding text or markdown."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "A simplified JSON representation of the endpoints and payloads is acceptable instead of a full OpenAPI specification.",
    "Standard CRUD operations are the only required functionalities.",
    "The Task model requires only basic attributes such as id, title, description, and status."
  ],
  "non_goals": [
    "Writing backend server implementation code.",
    "Designing the underlying database schema or storage structure.",
    "Including authentication, authorization, or security mechanisms.",
    "Implementing real-time updates or complex filtering."
  ],
  "acceptance": [
    "The output is a single, parseable JSON object with no markdown formatting or prose.",
    "The JSON explicitly defines the HTTP methods and paths for task CRUD operations.",
    "The JSON explicitly defines the request and response payload structures for the Task resource.",
    "The design excludes authentication and complex enterprise features."
  ],
  "risks": [
    "Ambiguity regarding whether the user expects a standard OpenAPI JSON or a custom simplified JSON structure.",
    "Over-minimalization might result in the omission of standard REST conventions like HTTP status codes or error response formats."
  ]
}
